# Brewfolio — GitHub Copilot Instructions

Brewfolio is a craft beer discovery and personal logging platform. This file is the source of truth for all AI assistance in this repo.

---

## Tech Stack

| Layer    | Technology |
|----------|-----------|
| Backend  | .NET 10 · FastEndpoints · EF Core (code-first) · PostgreSQL |
| Frontend | Next.js 15 (App Router) · Tailwind CSS v4 · TypeScript |
| Infra    | Docker Compose · Raspberry Pi 5 |

---

## Critical Rules — Backend

- **Always use FastEndpoints** — never MVC controllers, never minimal API (`app.MapGet(...)`)
- Every endpoint lives in `src/BRF.Api/Features/<Entity>/<FeatureName>/` (e.g. `Features/Articles/GetArticle/`)
- File naming: `GetArticleEndpoint.cs`, `GetArticleRequest.cs`, `GetArticleResponse.cs` — all inside the feature subfolder
- Namespace follows folder depth: `BRF.Api.Features.Articles.GetArticle`
- Endpoints call DbContext directly — **no service layer in MVP**
- All PKs are `Guid`, generated by the app (not DB)
- Always `async`/`await`; return `Results<Ok<T>, NotFound>` typed results
- `CreatedAt` is UTC on every entity

### FastEndpoints pattern
```csharp
public class GetBreweryEndpoint : Endpoint<GetBreweryRequest, GetBreweryResponse>
{
    private readonly AppDbContext _db;
    public GetBreweryEndpoint(AppDbContext db) => _db = db;

    public override void Configure()
    {
        Get("/breweries/{id}");
        AllowAnonymous();
    }

    public override async Task HandleAsync(GetBreweryRequest req, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var brewery = await _db.Breweries.FindAsync(req.Id, ct);
        if (brewery is null) { await SendNotFoundAsync(ct); return; }
        await SendOkAsync(brewery.ToResponse(), ct);
    }
}
```

---

## Critical Rules — Frontend

- **Next.js App Router only** — no Pages Router patterns
- Route groups: `(catalog)`, `(log)`, `(news)` under `app/`
- Prefer **Server Components** for data fetching; use `"use client"` only for interactivity
- Fetch from `process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL`
- **Tailwind CSS v4** — `@import "tailwindcss"` in globals.css (no `@tailwind` directives)
- Google Fonts loaded via `<link>` in `app/layout.tsx` `<head>`, NOT via CSS `@import url()`

### Design system (must follow)
- Background: `bg-white` / `bg-stone-50`
- Accent: `orange-600` (hover: `orange-700`)
- Font: **Public Sans** — no Epilogue, no Work Sans, no system-ui
- Icons: **Material Symbols Outlined** (`<span className="material-symbols-outlined">icon_name</span>`)
- No dark mode classes in new code
- No inline hex colors (`#ffbe5b`, `#1c1b1b`, etc.)

## Project Structure

```
src/
├── BRF.Api/
│   ├── Features/
│   │   ├── Breweries/
│   │   │   ├── GetBrewery/     ← Endpoint.cs + Request.cs + Response.cs
│   │   │   ├── ListBreweries/
│   │   │   └── CreateBrewery/
│   │   ├── Beers/
│   │   ├── Venues/
│   │   ├── BeerLogs/
│   │   └── Articles/
│   │       ├── GetArticle/
│   │       └── ListArticles/
│   ├── Domain/             ← EF Core entity classes
│   ├── Data/               ← AppDbContext, migrations
│   └── Program.cs
└── brf-web/                ← Next.js frontend (note: lowercase)
    ├── app/
    │   ├── (catalog)/      ← /beers, /breweries, /venues
    │   ├── (log)/          ← /log
    │   └── (news)/         ← /news
    ├── components/
    │   └── ui/             ← Stitch-generated components (do not modify)
    └── lib/
        └── mock-data.ts    ← TypeScript mock data (used until API is wired)
```

---

## Data Model (EF Core entities)

```
Brewery   — Id(Guid), Name, Country, City, Description?, CreatedAt
Beer      — Id(Guid), Name, Style, Abv(decimal?), Description?, BreweryId(FK), CreatedAt
Venue     — Id(Guid), Name, Type(enum), City, Description?, CreatedAt
BeerLog   — Id(Guid), UserId(string), BeerId(FK), VenueId?(FK), LoggedAt, Notes?, Rating(int? 1-5)
Article   — Id(Guid), Title, Content, AuthorId(string), Tag(string), PublishedAt, CreatedAt
```

VenueType enum: `Pub | Taproom | BottleShop | Other`

---

## What Is Deferred — Do NOT Build

- Auth / login (UserId is a plain `string` placeholder for now)
- Beer ↔ Venue many-to-many join table
- Rich text editor for articles
- Image uploads
- Social features (feeds, follows, likes)
- Map / geo features
- Mobile app

---

## Local Dev

```bash
docker-compose up -d          # start Postgres
cd src/BRF.Api && dotnet run  # API on :5000
cd src/brf-web && npm run dev # FE on :3000
```

API connection string: `appsettings.Development.json` → `ConnectionStrings:Default`  
FE env: `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:5000`
